cohort: 2494 newborns less than 72 hours old retrieved by the Newborn and Paediatric Emergency Transport Service (NETS) from January 1, 2006 to December 31, 2009
finding: Potentially avoidable newborn retrievals represented a small but significant proportion of total retrievals and decreased over the study period, with discretionary cesarean section being the most common cause.
mod_finding: Discretionary cesarean section was the most common cause of potentially avoidable newborn retrievals.
